#### 124 - Line fill volume changed

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="125">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />125 - Finalized custody batch was saved, but reverse rebook record was not created</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="125">

When the FLOWCAL option "Create Reversal Tickets on Edit" is enabled, a batch that has a class of Custody is edited, and the new revision that is created has a status of Final, FLOWCAL will compare the new revision to the record's prior revision that has a status of Final, Confirmed, or Closed. If no data point was changed that is in FC_REVERSAL_FIELD or FC_REVERSAL_COMPONENT_FIELD for the corresponding ticket type and system, then a reversal record is not created in the FC_BATCH_REPORT_DUP table and this message will be generated.

- Message Text: Finalized custody batch was saved, but reverse rebook record was not created
- Data 1 Usage: Effective Date
- Data 2 Usage: Effective End Date
- Data 3 Usage: Batch Index
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### <a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="126">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />126 - Invalid TQ value for extension definition</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="126">

This message is generated upon import of meter configuration data using transaction queue. Extension definition is a field in transaction snapshot import. If a value is provided for the extension definition field that is not one of the valid values, this message is generated against the meter being imported, and the record is not imported. See transaction queue documentation for details on the format, including valid values for extension definition.

- Data 1 Usage: Effective Date
- Data 2 Usage: Extension definition in TQ
- Message Class: Information
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

#### 127 - Meter data purged (FcDataBoss)

#### 128 - Meter data purge failed (FcDataBoss)

<a href="javascript:void(0);" class="MCToggler MCTogglerHead MCTogglerHotSpot MCToggler_Open toggler togglerexception MCTogglerHotSpot_ MCTogglerHotSpot_exception MCHotSpotImage" data-mc-targets="151">

<img src="data:image/gif;base64," class="MCToggler_Image_Icon" data-mc-alt2="Open" width="16" height="11" alt="Closed" />151 - Failed to send calculated meter analysis to designated quality source</a>

<div class="drop-down" style="display: none;" mc-target-name="151">

When the calculated meter rollup service is unable to transfer a meter’s analysis to a source, as configured in the “Send To” section of a source assignment, it will postpone the rollup queue entry and write this message. A typical cause for this failure is a locked source due to an in-progress user edit. Re-queuing the postponed entry will often solve the problem.

- Message Text: Failed to send calculated meter analysis to designated quality source
- Data 1 Usage: Source Number
- Data 2 Usage: Queue Entry Start Date
- Data 3 Usage: Queue Entry End Date
- Message Class: Error
- Message Priority: 5

</div>

</div>
